note: What the published @cyber-est/cli holds, read from its npm tarball by `node scripts/est-agent-guide.mjs --snapshot`. Never edit by hand.

compare.summary: Render the same input through two bundles (or a bundle and a desktop WAV) and report how they differ

dev.summary: Play a plugin in the dev host while you build it (http://localhost:4430; --json headless)

doctor.summary: Check Node, the meter, rustup with wasm32-unknown-unknown, cargo, asc and clang for wasm32; print the command for anything missing

inspect.summary: Show a .est bundle's manifest, files and module (imports, exports, memory, metering)

keygen.summary: Make your developer signing key (outside any repository); paste its public key into Cyber

login.summary: Log in to Cyber to publish (a code you approve in the browser; the token lasts an hour)

new.summary: Make a plugin folder from a template (effect, instrument, sampler, midi-effect, visualiser: -rust or -as, cpp-clap) or a cookbook recipe

pack.summary: Build a plugin folder and pack it to dist/<id>-<version>.est

profile.summary: Show where a block's fuel goes, function by function (the functions by fuel, share and calls)

publish.summary: Publish your .est bundle to Cyber (est login first; est validate it first)
usage: est publish <file.est> [--screenshots a.png b.png …] [--changelog <file>] [--homepage <url>] [--source-url <url>] [--support <url>] [--key <your developer key>] [--early-only] [--to <url>] [--json]

sign.summary: Sign a .est bundle as its developer (writes <file>.developer.json for est publish)

test.summary: Run the plugin's golden render (test/golden.json) and the conformance run

validate.summary: Validate a plugin folder (built and packed first) or a .est; writes validation.json

yank.summary: Hide one of your published versions (still installable by exact pin); --undo unhides it
